newsitem.title: USA: Aspen Technology buys Bechtel's PIMS unit.
newsitem.headline: Aspen Technology buys Bechtel's PIMS unit.

text.p: Aspen Technology Inc said on Wednesday it bought Bechtel Corp's Process Industries Modeling System business for $9.85 million in cash and stock.

The acquisition will not dilute Aspen's fiscal 1997 earnings, the company added. But it said it will take a one-time charge of $7.75 million for the acquisition for in-process research and development.
It did not say in which quarter it would take the charge.
Aspen added that the stock-for-stock exchange in the deal will be used to acquire Basil Joffe Associates Inc, which develops software, the company said.
Officials from Aspen were not immediately available.
Houston-based PIMS provides software products for planning and scheduling in the process industries, and had about $6.0 million in revenues in 1996, Aspen said.
